commits.subject: Add policy-checked TCP upstream tunneling for SOCKS (#60523)
commits.reason: Primary admission, direct-dial, HTTP/MITM and SOCKS paths inspected: destination-scoped approval does not transfer to another port or hostname; explicit IP deny survives approval and mapped/numeric aliases; remote DNS requires policy independent of resolved IP. Executor supplies the mandatory next hop, with no direct fallback after tunnel refusal. Linux relay preserves original names, rejects unassigned synthetic addresses, bounds name and worker capacity, and validates managed ports before bridge creation. Source review is not platform qualification: network-proxy native tests and Linux sandbox tests remain required.
